newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish police put down prison riots; seven dead.
newsitem.headline: Turkish police put down prison riots; seven dead.

text.p: Baton-wielding police on Wednesday quelled a riot at an Istanbul prison in which five people were killed, while two inmates died in a separate disturbance in a jail in western Turkey.

"Our ambulances have carried five dead and five wounded from the Metris prison. We don't know if there are any more inside," an Istanbul health board official told Reuters. He had earlier said eight people died in Metris.
